description: Make an AI video from the user's prompt with a chosen MakeViral Create model (Seedance, Kling, Veo, Wan, Grok Imagine, MiniMax...): from text, from a start frame photo (and an end frame on some models), or from references (photos, clips and sounds), with Kling multi-shot and elements. It spends credits from the user's MakeViral account (a failed video gives them back). A video takes a few minutes: this call returns at once, then call get_creation with wait true until it is ready and give the user the link. Before calling: 1) pick the model and check what it takes with get_model, 2) tell the user the price in credits, 3) with photos or clips, ask the user to confirm the people in them are them or agreed, and that no one is a child. Files: pass files the user attached in this chat (startFrame, endFrame, referencePhotos, referenceSounds), or public https links in the *Url fields. Clips must be links (MP4 or MOV). Never use photos of a public figure or of someone who did not agree. Calling again with the same input within 10 minutes returns the first video; pass a new requestId to make another.

aspect.description: Shape. Default 9:16 (vertical). With a start frame most models follow the photo's shape.

autoShots.description: Kling Omni: the model plans the shots itself

clipMode.description: Kling Omni with a clip: 'edit' changes the clip itself (default), 'reference' makes a new video from it

count.description: How many videos (each one is charged). Default 1.

durationSec.description: Length in seconds (get_model lists them). Default: the model's default.

elementPhotos.description: The element photos attached in the chat, element by element in order

elements.description: Kling 3.0 elements: people or things from 2-4 photos each

description.description: Who or what it is, in a few words

name.description: Lower case, e.g. 'mia'; write @mia in the prompt

photoCount.description: How many of elementPhotos belong to it, in order

endFrame.description: The last frame (models with an end frame), with a start frame

endFrameUrl.description: The last frame as a public https photo link

keepClipSound.description: With a clip: put the clip's own sound on the result

model.description: Video model id (list_models). seedance-2-5 is a good default.

photosConsent.description: Needed with photos or clips: true only after the user confirmed everyone in them is the user or agreed, and no one is a child

prompt.description: What happens in the video. With references, name them as get_model says (e.g. [Image 1]).

referenceClipUrls.description: Reference clips as public https links to an MP4 or MOV file

referenceClips.description: Reference clips (MP4 or MOV) as files, where the chat can attach them

referencePhotoUrls.description: Reference photos as public https links

referencePhotos.description: Reference photos attached in the chat (people, products, a style). Never with frames.

referenceSoundUrls.description: Reference sounds as public https links

referenceSounds.description: Reference sounds (MP3 or WAV) attached in the chat

requestId.description: Optional id (8-64 letters, digits, - or _). The same id never charges twice.

shots.description: Kling multi-shot: each shot's prompt and length; they add up to the video length

sound.description: Sound on or off where the model has the choice. Default on.

startFrame.description: The first frame: a photo the user attached in the chat

startFrameUrl.description: The first frame as a public https photo link

webSearch.description: Seedance, text to video only: look things up online

name: create_video
title: Make an AI video
